issue_context.title: Don't show fill  icons when background is transparent
issue_context.body:
That users might not be able to figure out immediately that they might have background transparent due to which fill is not working. 
so hiding the fill icons would make the workflow more intuitive and clear as one can then never have a buggy scenario.
comments: We should introduce automatic tests for those changes.

review_comments: I'd rather have a UI test instead of a unit test. Unit test tells us nothing much here.

There is already a UI test added and we can add more if needed but for utils, I feel we should also have unit tests since utils are pure js functions that can be used at multiple places, and if we later export it to the package `excalidraw-utils` the unit test helps.
Alright, I only skimmed the test titles, but it seems it's testing even the case where it shouldn't show. Good.
We should have both, and I agree with @ad1992 we should add more unit tests for our utils.. not in this PR, but in general
